title.narrative:
Zantchito-Overall Objective of the project: to promote entrepreneurial culture, sustainable enterprise creation and decent, formal jobs.
Project Purpose: to provide technical assistance and seed capital to pre-incubated and incubated ideas capable of evolving into commercially viable enterprises for the Malawian market.
Project activities: 1) Business Incubation Strengthening; 2) Business Development Services Strengthening; 3) TEVET graduates and MSE (potential and existing) Pre-Incubation, Incubation and Post-Incubation Support; 4) TEVET graduates and MSE (potential and existing) Pre-Incubation, Incubation and Post-Incubation Financing Facility; 5) Substantive Learning Agenda.
